// Offline provenance only. No Loki/Pulse imports or parser execution.
// Usage: producer /path/to/pinned/loki > http-parameters.json
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"go/ast"
	"go/constant"
	"go/parser"
	"go/printer"
	"go/token"
	"math/big"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const revision = "5aa4b9212d64d723f63b2770452054aa23df114d"

var sources = []struct{ file, hash string }{
	{"query_test.go", "ed3ebc61ce82f3118955ecb70b5010687352c4a7e9ecb33ea3b698a8656af96c"},
	{"params_test.go", "00ad859e9cb323df72f8c5b16b495f7e3dd64b9b918c2823ed2a36b6c25176be"},
	{"labels_test.go", "a1c156f03b2b722b580522db64445ed87272fc61dbd0203c548439c0cc36f958"},
	{"series_test.go", "a5b0b428c8b6d5f7987620c442472994904a7182c4f28d412852ec5cfbd9d48b"},
	{"tail_test.go", "cd360528565522af9acbd35b22ad2d853033e6cad94d8ca231edb1fffd8cb7f0"},
	{"patterns_test.go", "a04cf415adefb5a93488f5406d17ba9c2353865710f208287390a1fee89945df"},
}

var selected = map[string]bool{
	"TestParseRangeQuery": true, "TestParseInstantQuery": true,
	"Test_ParseVolumeInstantQuery": true, "Test_ParseVolumeRangeQuery": true,
	"TestParseLabelQuery": true, "TestParseAndValidateSeriesQuery": true,
	"TestParseTailQuery": true, "TestParsePatternsQuery": true,
}

type object map[string]any
type typed struct {
	name   string
	fields object
}
type raw string
type extractor struct {
	fs          *token.FileSet
	source      []byte
	types       map[string]*ast.StructType
	file, table string
	rows        []object
}

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
func (x *extractor) code(n ast.Node) string {
	return string(x.source[x.fs.Position(n.Pos()).Offset:x.fs.Position(n.End()).Offset])
}
func printed(n ast.Node) string {
	var b bytes.Buffer
	must(printer.Fprint(&b, token.NewFileSet(), n))
	return b.String()
}
func numeric(v any) constant.Value {
	switch n := v.(type) {
	case constant.Value:
		return n
	case time.Duration:
		return constant.MakeInt64(int64(n))
	}
	panic(fmt.Sprintf("not numeric: %#v", v))
}
func integer(v any) int64 {
	n, ok := constant.Int64Val(constant.ToInt(numeric(v)))
	if !ok {
		panic("not exact int64")
	}
	return n
}

// Interpret only expressions present in the pinned original wants and inputs.
// Unknown syntax fails closed; no parser result is used as an oracle.
func (x *extractor) value(e ast.Expr, env object) any {
	switch n := e.(type) {
	case *ast.BasicLit:
		if n.Kind == token.STRING {
			s, err := strconv.Unquote(n.Value)
			must(err)
			return s
		}
		return constant.MakeFromLiteral(n.Value, n.Kind, 0)
	case *ast.Ident:
		switch n.Name {
		case "nil":
			return nil
		case "true":
			return true
		case "false":
			return false
		}
		if v, ok := env[n.Name]; ok {
			return v
		}
		panic("unbound identifier: " + n.Name)
	case *ast.UnaryExpr:
		v := x.value(n.X, env)
		if n.Op == token.AND {
			return v
		}
		return constant.UnaryOp(n.Op, numeric(v), 0)
	case *ast.ParenExpr:
		return x.value(n.X, env)
	case *ast.BinaryExpr:
		a, b := x.value(n.X, env), x.value(n.Y, env)
		if s, ok := a.(string); ok && n.Op == token.ADD {
			return s + b.(string)
		}
		return constant.BinaryOp(numeric(a), n.Op, numeric(b))
	case *ast.SelectorExpr:
		s := printed(n)
		switch s {
		case "time.Second":
			return time.Second
		case "time.Minute":
			return time.Minute
		case "time.Hour":
			return time.Hour
		case "time.Millisecond":
			return time.Millisecond
		case "time.UTC":
			return time.UTC
		case "math.MaxUint32":
			return constant.MakeUint64(4294967295)
		case "logproto.BACKWARD":
			return "BACKWARD"
		case "logproto.FORWARD":
			return "FORWARD"
		case "assert.NoError":
			return object{"reject": false, "assertion": "assert.NoError"}
		}
		panic("unknown selector: " + s)
	case *ast.FuncLit:
		// uint32 component wrappers and determineBounds error callbacks.
		var result any
		ast.Inspect(n.Body, func(node ast.Node) bool {
			if r, ok := node.(*ast.ReturnStmt); ok {
				call := r.Results[0].(*ast.CallExpr)
				if printed(call.Fun) == "assert.ErrorContains" {
					result = object{"reject": true, "assertion": "assert.ErrorContains", "contains": x.value(call.Args[2], env)}
				} else {
					result = printed(call.Fun)
				}
			}
			return true
		})
		if result == nil {
			panic("unrecognized callback")
		}
		return result
	case *ast.CallExpr:
		fun := printed(n.Fun)
		args := []any{}
		for _, a := range n.Args {
			args = append(args, x.value(a, env))
		}
		switch fun {
		case "time.Now":
			return time.Date(2022, 12, 18, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
		case "time.Unix":
			return time.Unix(integer(args[0]), integer(args[1])).UTC()
		case "time.Date":
			return time.Date(int(integer(args[0])), time.Month(integer(args[1])), int(integer(args[2])), int(integer(args[3])), int(integer(args[4])), int(integer(args[5])), int(integer(args[6])), time.UTC)
		case "timePtr", "mustParseURL", "withForm":
			return args[0]
		case "uint64":
			return args[0]
		case "fmt.Sprintf":
			return fmt.Sprintf(args[0].(string), integer(args[1]))
		case "requestWithVar":
			req := args[0].(typed)
			req.fields["path_variables"] = object{args[1].(string): args[2]}
			return req
		case "testutil.MustPlan":
			return object{"expression": args[0], "constructor": fun}
		case "mkSeriesRequest":
			// The original helper calls bounds; its explicit decimal-second inputs
			// here are converted with stdlib only, not by running Loki bounds.
			from, err := strconv.ParseInt(args[1].(string), 10, 64)
			must(err)
			to, err := strconv.ParseInt(args[2].(string), 10, 64)
			must(err)
			return typed{"logproto.SeriesRequest", object{"Start": time.Unix(from, 0), "End": time.Unix(to, 0), "Groups": args[3]}}
		}
		if sel, ok := n.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr); ok && sel.Sel.Name == "Milliseconds" {
			return constant.MakeInt64(integer(x.value(sel.X, env)) / int64(time.Millisecond))
		}
		panic("unknown call: " + fun)
	case *ast.CompositeLit:
		if _, ok := n.Type.(*ast.ArrayType); ok {
			out := []any{}
			for _, e := range n.Elts {
				out = append(out, x.value(e, env))
			}
			return out
		}
		name := ""
		if n.Type != nil {
			name = printed(n.Type)
		}
		out := object{}
		st, _ := n.Type.(*ast.StructType)
		if id, ok := n.Type.(*ast.Ident); ok {
			st = x.types[id.Name]
		}
		for i, e := range n.Elts {
			if kv, ok := e.(*ast.KeyValueExpr); ok {
				key := ""
				if id, ok := kv.Key.(*ast.Ident); ok {
					key = id.Name
				} else {
					key = x.value(kv.Key, env).(string)
				}
				out[key] = x.value(kv.Value, env)
			} else {
				if st == nil {
					panic("positional composite without type")
				}
				out[st.Fields.List[i].Names[0].Name] = x.value(e, env)
			}
		}
		if name == "url.Values" || name == "args" {
			return out
		}
		if name == "time.Time" {
			return time.Time{}
		}
		return typed{name, out}
	}
	panic(fmt.Sprintf("unsupported expression %T: %s", e, printed(e)))
}

func ns(t time.Time) string {
	n := new(big.Int).Mul(big.NewInt(t.Unix()), big.NewInt(1000000000))
	return n.Add(n, big.NewInt(int64(t.Nanosecond()))).String()
}

func normalize(v any) any {
	switch n := v.(type) {
	case constant.Value:
		if i, ok := constant.Int64Val(constant.ToInt(n)); ok {
			return i
		}
		panic("noninteger normalized constant")
	case time.Time:
		return ns(n)
	case time.Duration:
		return strconv.FormatInt(int64(n), 10)
	case typed:
		out := object{}
		for k, v := range n.fields {
			key := k
			if _, ok := v.(time.Time); ok {
				key += "_ns"
			}
			if k == "Step" || k == "Interval" {
				factor := int64(1)
				if n.name == "logproto.QueryPatternsRequest" {
					factor = 1000000
				}
				out[k+"_ns"] = strconv.FormatInt(integer(v)*factor, 10)
				continue
			}
			out[key] = normalize(v)
		}
		return object{"type": n.name, "fields": out}
	case object:
		out := object{}
		for k, v := range n {
			key := k
			if _, ok := v.(time.Time); ok {
				key += "_ns"
			}
			out[key] = normalize(v)
		}
		return out
	case []any:
		out := []any{}
		for _, v := range n {
			out = append(out, normalize(v))
		}
		return out
	}
	return v
}

func (x *extractor) base(n ast.Node, name string) object {
	return object{"table": x.table, "name": name, "source": x.file,
		"lines": []int{x.fs.Position(n.Pos()).Line, x.fs.Position(n.End()).Line}, "original_go": x.code(n)}
}

func (x *extractor) tableRows(lit *ast.CompositeLit, env object) {
	var st *ast.StructType
	switch typ := lit.Type.(type) {
	case *ast.ArrayType:
		st = typ.Elt.(*ast.StructType)
	case *ast.MapType:
		st = typ.Value.(*ast.StructType)
	default:
		panic("unknown table kind")
	}
	for _, elt := range lit.Elts {
		name := ""
		if kv, ok := elt.(*ast.KeyValueExpr); ok {
			name = x.value(kv.Key, env).(string)
			elt = kv.Value
		}
		rowLit := elt.(*ast.CompositeLit)
		// Elided literal type is supplied by the actual original table declaration.
		copyLit := *rowLit
		copyLit.Type = st
		data := x.value(&copyLit, env).(typed).fields
		for _, k := range []string{"name", "desc"} {
			if v, ok := data[k]; ok {
				name = v.(string)
			}
		}
		row := x.base(elt, name)
		input := object{}
		for _, k := range []string{"r", "input", "path", "reqPath", "value", "def", "args", "start", "end"} {
			if v, ok := data[k]; ok {
				input[k] = v
			}
		}
		// determineBounds has output start/end, not input start/end.
		if x.table == "Test_determineBounds" {
			delete(input, "start")
			delete(input, "end")
		}
		if v, ok := data["parse"]; ok {
			row["component"] = v
		}
		row["input"] = normalize(input)
		var expected any
		if v, ok := data["want"]; ok {
			expected = v
		} else {
			expected = data["expected"]
		}
		if x.table == "Test_determineBounds" {
			expected = typed{"bounds", object{"Start": data["start"], "End": data["end"]}}
		}
		if x.table == "Test_interval" {
			expected = strconv.FormatInt(integer(expected), 10)
			row["expected_unit"] = "nanoseconds"
		}
		if x.table == "TestHttp_defaultQueryRangeStep" {
			expected = strconv.FormatInt(integer(expected)*int64(time.Second), 10)
			row["expected_unit"] = "nanoseconds (original integer seconds multiplied by 1e9)"
		}
		if x.table == "Test_parseTimestamp" {
			row["expected_unit"] = "unix nanoseconds"
		}
		row["expected"] = normalize(expected)
		row["expectation_scope"] = "original asserted value; omitted Go struct fields are zero values"
		err := object{"reject": false, "assertion": "NoError"}
		for _, k := range []string{"wantErr", "shouldErr"} {
			if v, ok := data[k]; ok {
				switch z := v.(type) {
				case bool:
					err = object{"reject": z, "assertion": "error presence only"}
				case string:
					err = object{"reject": true, "assertion": "require.Error + assert.ErrorContains", "contains": z}
				case object:
					err = z
				default:
					panic("unknown error expectation")
				}
			}
		}
		err["asserted"] = true
		row["expected_asserted"] = true
		if x.table == "Test_uint32QueryParamBounds" {
			row["expected_asserted"] = false // Original invocation discards its value.
		}
		if x.table == "Test_interval" && err["reject"].(bool) {
			row["expected_asserted"] = false // Keep the literal zero, but do not upgrade it to an oracle.
		}
		if x.table == "TestHttp_defaultQueryRangeStep" {
			err["asserted"] = false
			err["assertion"] = "not applicable: component returns no error"
		}
		// interval's success branch asserts only the value, not err == nil.
		if x.table == "Test_interval" && !err["reject"].(bool) {
			err["asserted"] = false
			err["assertion"] = "not asserted on success branch"
		}
		row["error"] = err
		if x.table == "Test_parseTimestamp" {
			row["clock"] = object{"original": "now := time.Now()", "fixed_now_ns": ns(env["now"].(time.Time)), "substitution": "deterministic producer clock; original default/want alias preserved"}
		}
		x.rows = append(x.rows, row)
	}
}

// The volume tests are imperative assertion groups, not Go table literals.
// Walk original t.Run scopes and collect only the values actually asserted.
func (x *extractor) volume(block *ast.BlockStmt, parent object, path string) {
	env := object{}
	for k, v := range parent {
		env[k] = v
	}
	var reqNode ast.Node
	var expected any
	var errExpectation object
	for _, stmt := range block.List {
		switch s := stmt.(type) {
		case *ast.AssignStmt:
			id, ok := s.Lhs[0].(*ast.Ident)
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			if id.Name == "req" || id.Name == "url" || id.Name == "expected" {
				env[id.Name] = x.value(s.Rhs[0], env)
				if id.Name == "req" {
					reqNode = s
				}
			}
		case *ast.ExprStmt:
			call, ok := s.X.(*ast.CallExpr)
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			fun := printed(call.Fun)
			switch fun {
			case "t.Run":
				child := x.value(call.Args[0], env).(string)
				if path != "" {
					child = path + "/" + child
				}
				x.volume(call.Args[1].(*ast.FuncLit).Body, env, child)
			case "require.Equal":
				expected = x.value(call.Args[1], env)
				if printed(call.Args[2]) == "actual.AggregateBy" {
					expected = object{"AggregateBy": expected}
				}
				errExpectation = object{"reject": false, "assertion": "require.NoError"}
			case "require.EqualError":
				errExpectation = object{"reject": true, "assertion": "require.EqualError", "equals": x.value(call.Args[2], env)}
			}
		}
	}
	if reqNode != nil && errExpectation != nil {
		// Empty path means the original top-level group has no subtest name.
		row := x.base(block, path)
		row["input"] = normalize(object{"r": env["req"]})
		row["expected"] = normalize(expected)
		row["expected_asserted"] = expected != nil
		errExpectation["asserted"] = true
		row["error"] = errExpectation
		row["expectation_scope"] = "original assertions only; aggregate by/labels asserts AggregateBy only"
		x.rows = append(x.rows, row)
	}
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		panic("usage: producer /path/to/pinned/loki")
	}
	x := &extractor{fs: token.NewFileSet(), rows: []object{}}
	metadata := []object{}
	selections := []object{}
	for _, src := range sources {
		x.file = "pkg/loghttp/" + src.file
		b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(os.Args[1], x.file))
		must(err)
		if fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(b)) != src.hash {
			panic("source differs from pinned " + x.file)
		}
		x.source = b
		metadata = append(metadata, object{"path": x.file, "sha256": src.hash})
		f, err := parser.ParseFile(x.fs, x.file, b, 0)
		must(err)
		for _, decl := range f.Decls {
			fn, ok := decl.(*ast.FuncDecl)
			if !ok || !(selected[fn.Name.Name] || src.file == "params_test.go" && strings.HasPrefix(fn.Name.Name, "Test")) {
				continue
			}
			x.table = fn.Name.Name
			start := len(x.rows)
			selection := x.code(fn) + "\n"
			selections = append(selections, object{"table": x.table, "source": x.file, "lines": []int{x.fs.Position(fn.Pos()).Line, x.fs.Position(fn.End()).Line}, "sha256": fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256([]byte(selection))), "original_go": selection})
			x.types = map[string]*ast.StructType{}
			ast.Inspect(fn.Body, func(n ast.Node) bool {
				if ts, ok := n.(*ast.TypeSpec); ok {
					if st, ok := ts.Type.(*ast.StructType); ok {
						x.types[ts.Name.Name] = st
					}
				}
				return true
			})
			env := object{"t": raw("testing.T")}
			if strings.HasPrefix(x.table, "Test_ParseVolume") {
				x.volume(fn.Body, env, "")
				// The walker discovers children first; restore source-order parent/children.
				groups := x.rows[start:]
				if len(groups) != 3 {
					panic("expected three volume assertion groups")
				}
				groups[0], groups[1], groups[2] = groups[2], groups[0], groups[1]
			} else {
				for _, stmt := range fn.Body.List {
					switch s := stmt.(type) {
					case *ast.AssignStmt:
						id := s.Lhs[0].(*ast.Ident).Name
						if id == "now" {
							env[id] = x.value(s.Rhs[0], env)
						}
						if id == "tests" {
							x.tableRows(s.Rhs[0].(*ast.CompositeLit), env)
						}
					case *ast.RangeStmt:
						if lit, ok := s.X.(*ast.CompositeLit); ok {
							x.tableRows(lit, env)
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if len(x.rows) == start {
				panic("selected test yielded no rows: " + x.table)
			}
			selections[len(selections)-1]["rows"] = len(x.rows) - start
		}
	}
	if len(selections) != 15 {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("expected 15 selected tests, got %d", len(selections)))
	}
	out := object{"schema_version": 1, "revision": revision, "sources": metadata, "selections": selections, "rows": x.rows}
	e := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	e.SetIndent("", "  ")
	e.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	must(e.Encode(out))
}
